headline: Final canvass of voting rolls for the September 9, 2026 Democratic/Republican Primary and update on nomination paper challenges.
summary: The meeting will cover the final canvass of voting rolls for the September 9, 2026 primary. It will also include an update on challenges to nomination papers and the start of early voting.
items: Public input period; email testimony accepted until 11:00 a.m. on the meeting day
Update on the July 23, 2026 Board of Election meeting regarding challenges to nomination papers
Reminder: supervisor classes at City Hall on August 20, 2026 at 11 a.m. and 5 p.m.
Reminder: warden and clerk classes at the City Hall Annex on August 24, 2026 at 5 p.m. and 7 p.m.
Early voting starts August 20, 2026 at the Blackstone Valley Visitors Center, 175 Main St.
Final canvass of voting rolls for the September 9, 2026 Democratic/Republican Primary; vote may be taken
Discuss primary day duties and concerns
Members to receive a copy of the 2026 Poll Worker manual
Members to be informed of changes to the Poll Worker class
Next meeting on September 9, 2026 to conduct the Democratic/Republican Primary at Pawtucket City Hall, 137 Roosevelt Ave., Room 303, at 6:00 A.M.
